thiagoxikota-figma-maxxing-figma-bridge-.description: Diagnose or restore the figma-console Desktop Bridge with a minimal state-based action and verified pairing. Recovery is session-safe; macOS scripts, restart and persistent helpers keep their own permissions.
thiagoxikota-figma-maxxing-figma-bridge-.author: Thiago Xikota

thiagoxikota-figma-maxxing-figma-canon.description: Read-only Figma technical canon and production gotchas. Load the reference needed for the current inspection, write, design-system operation or handoff; project rules and authorization prevail.
thiagoxikota-figma-maxxing-figma-canon.author: Thiago Xikota

thiagoxikota-figma-maxxing-figma-click-f.description: Draw or refresh a static click-flow overlay on laid-out Figma screens from prototype reactions or explicit pairs, using the existing SVG recipe and verified targets.
thiagoxikota-figma-maxxing-figma-click-f.author: Thiago Xikota

thiagoxikota-figma-maxxing-figma-comment.description: Apply requested Figma review comments to their pinned screens with scoped discovery, idempotent fixes and private evidence. Existing authorization governs writes; public replies need an explicit request.
thiagoxikota-figma-maxxing-figma-comment.author: Thiago Xikota

thiagoxikota-figma-maxxing-figma-handoff.description: Audit a Figma handoff for action/state completeness, readable annotations, recipient use and valid proof. Read-only review and already authorized correction remain distinct; no fixed review-role ritual.
thiagoxikota-figma-maxxing-figma-handoff.author: Thiago Xikota

thiagoxikota-figma-maxxing-figma-orient.description: Map a new or unfamiliar Figma scope without canvas writes, reuse verified project maps, and record pages/screens/DS plus coverage. Persistence follows project privacy and the actual runtime's authorization.
thiagoxikota-figma-maxxing-figma-orient.author: Thiago Xikota

thiagoxikota-figma-maxxing-figma-preflig.description: Read-only preflight for an authorized Figma write: correct live target, applicable DS/API context, states and single-writer lock; also supports requested flow-graph audits.
thiagoxikota-figma-maxxing-figma-preflig.author: Thiago Xikota

thiagoxikota-figma-maxxing-figma-slop-ch.description: Review the craft and technical precision of a requested Figma scope with project canon, measures and visual evidence; classify swap/snap/ask while respecting existing correction authorization.
thiagoxikota-figma-maxxing-figma-slop-ch.author: Thiago Xikota
